title: SmartArt-like drawing docx 002
notes: python-docx cannot emit diagrams: raw w:drawing with one inline wpg:wgp group containing two wps:wsp ellipse shapes carrying wps:txbx text, injected via parse_xml. LibreOffice renders shape txbx text into the PDF text layer, so the labels are reference text. DrawingML shape group only — no diagram parts in 002, not MS-generated SmartArt.
